notes: The council has made more than $368,000 in grants since 2001, per the foundation. Ask the foundation how many seats are open this year.
name: Youth Advisory Council (health grants)
what_you_do: You learn how giving money for health works. You help pick which youth health programs get grants. Topics include mental health, bullying, basic needs and drug use prevention.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 8 to 12 who live in or near Columbus.
pay_detail: No pay stated. Time can count toward community service hours needed to graduate.
duration: Not stated on the page read; a 2023 foundation blog post described a council that starts each September
deadline_text: No deadline is posted on the Become a Member page.
how_to_apply: Download the member form from the page. Email it to youthcouncil@cmafohio.org. You can also mail it to the Youth Advisory Council Coordinator at 1390 Dublin Road, Columbus, OH 43215.
